historical_record.description: The Eng-Skell Building, built 1935 and rated Category I under Article 11 of the Planning Code; one of just nine rated downtown buildings put up between 1935 and 1970.

The Eng-Skell Building, a reinforced-concrete Art Deco industrial building designed by Port engineer A.C. Griewank; it has been owned and operated by the same food-processing and research company from its construction in 1930 to the present.
